complex.description: Nau'ikan shaida huɗu ko fiye, ko shaida da aka haɗa da lokaci/fuska.
complex.label: Rikitacce

moderate.description: Rarrabuwa ta hanyoyi uku (misali: kai tsaye, rahoto, yanke hukunci).
moderate.label: Matsakaici

none.description: Babu alamar nahawu na tushen bayanai.
none.label: Babu

optional.description: Alamomin da suka yi kama da shaida suna nan amma ba tilas ba ne.
optional.label: Na zaɓi

simple.description: Rarrabuwa ta hanyoyi biyu (yawanci kai tsaye da ba kai tsaye ba/rahoto).
simple.label: Sauƙi

maxClusterSize.name: Mafi yawan baƙaƙe a cikin tari

agglutinative.description: Ana gina kalmomi ta hanyar ƙara ƙari ɗaya bayan ɗaya, inda kowane ƙari ke ɗauke da ma'ana ɗaya kawai. Sassan suna nan a bayyane kamar tubalan da aka haɗa.
agglutinative.label: Haɗawa

fusional.description: Kalmomi suna canza sifansu ta hanyar ƙarshe da gaban-magana waɗanda ke haɗa ma'anoni da yawa na nahawu a lokaci guda. Ƙarshewa ɗaya na iya bayyana jinsi, lamba, da shari'a tare, wanda ke sa rarrabuwa ya yi wuya.
fusional.label: Haɗuwa

introflexive.description: Ana gina nahawu daga cikin kalmar: tushe na baƙaƙe yana ɗauke da ma'anar asali, yayin da tsare-tsaren wasali daban-daban da aka saka cikinsa ke ƙirƙirar sabbin kalmomi. Misali, tushen Larabci k-t-b yana da alaƙa da rubutu, kuma kataba, kitāb da kātib duk sun fito daga gare shi.
introflexive.label: Canjin ciki

isolating.description: Kalmomi yawanci sun ƙunshi morpheme ɗaya kuma ba sa canza sifansu. Ana bayyana nahawu ta hanyar tsarin kalma da kalmomi na aiki daban-daban maimakon ƙarshe ko gaban-magana.
isolating.label: Rarrabuwa

polysynthetic.description: Kalma ɗaya na iya bayyana abin da wasu yarukan za su faɗa a cikin jimla gaba ɗaya, ta hanyar haɗa fi'ili, mai aikata, abin da ake yi masa, da sauran abubuwa tare. Yafi zama gama-gari a cikin yarukan asali na Amurka da Arctic.
polysynthetic.label: Haɗuwa mai yawa

complex-tonal.description: Tsare-tsaren kari suna shafar ma'anar kalma sosai.
complex-tonal.label: Kari rikitacce

non-tonal.description: Canjin murya ba ya shafar ma'anar kalma.
non-tonal.label: Maras kari

pitch-accent.description: Yana amfani da lafazin murya, inda ake jaddada wasu syllabai ta canjin murya.
pitch-accent.label: Lafazin murya

simple-tonal.description: Canjin murya yana shafar ma'anar kalma a hankali.
simple-tonal.label: Kari sauƙi

complex.description: Nau'ikan fuska da yawa tare da alamomi masu arziki na ilimin sifar kalma.
complex.label: Rikitacce

minimal.description: Babu ko ƙarancin alamar nahawu na fuska.
minimal.label: Ƙarami

simple.description: Rarrabuwar fuska ta asali (misali: ci gaba, cikakke).
simple.label: Sauƙi

flexible.label: Mai sassauci

rigid.description: Kalmomi suna da matsayi na nahawu da aka ƙayyade.
rigid.label: Mai tsauri

semi-flexible.description: Ana ba da izinin wani bambanci na tsarin kalma don jaddadawa.
semi-flexible.label: Semi-mai sassauci
